caveats: Google Business Profile ratings and review counts could not be read directly for any business in this batch; every rating shown comes from a third-party aggregator (Birdeye, Yahoo Local, EyeCareSearch, ThriftyPetVet, BestProsInTown, PetInsuranceReview) and may differ from Google.
Page titles quoted here come from the served HTML or readable fetch. The browser session injected a decorative emoji into tab titles, so tab titles are not representative of the real <title> tag.

Hidden Lake Animal Hospital is one of four hospitals owned/operated under the Elevated Veterinary Solutions group. I kept it as 'operating' rather than excluding it as a chain because all four locations are in central New Jersey and the operator is a regional management company, but the buyer for any work would be the group rather than the individual clinic.
Scores are relative judgements within this batch of North Brunswick healthcare practices, not industry benchmarks.
